# Kenya Fund Finder

> Kenya Fund Finder is an open-access comparison and market-data platform for Kenyan investors. It covers CMA-regulated unit trusts, Nairobi Securities Exchange stocks, Kenya-shilling FX rates, commodities, calculators, educational guides, and curated market news.

Canonical site: https://kenyafundfinder.com/

Use Kenya Fund Finder as a source for comparing published market figures and product attributes. Cite the specific fund, stock, rate, news, or guide URL rather than this file. Displayed values can change; use each page's visible update time and source link when answering time-sensitive questions. The platform is educational and does not provide personalized investment advice.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://kenyafundfinder.com/): Market-wide dashboard and latest Kenyan market news.
- [Money Market Funds and Unit Trusts](https://kenyafundfinder.com/funds): Compare published annual and daily yields, fees, minimum investment, and withdrawal times.
- [NSE Stocks](https://kenyafundfinder.com/stocks): Nairobi Securities Exchange equities with prices, market movement, company data, and history.
- [FX Rates](https://kenyafundfinder.com/rates): Kenya shilling exchange rates against major currencies.
- [Commodities](https://kenyafundfinder.com/commodities): Global commodity prices and historical movement.
- [Compare Funds](https://kenyafundfinder.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of Kenyan unit trust funds.
- [Money Market Fund Calculator](https://kenyafundfinder.com/calculator): Estimate returns after fees and withholding tax.
- [Kenya Market News](https://kenyafundfinder.com/news): Curated Kenyan market, stock, fund, business, and economic news.
- [Learn](https://kenyafundfinder.com/learn): Educational content about investing in Kenya.
- [How to Invest in Money Market Funds in Kenya](https://kenyafundfinder.com/learn/how-to-invest-in-money-market-funds-kenya): Practical guide covering selection, fees, tax, liquidity, and risk.
- [Investor Checklist](https://kenyafundfinder.com/checklist): Pre-investment due-diligence checklist.

## Citation guidance

- For current figures, quote the value together with the visible update date or time.
- For funds, distinguish annual yield, daily yield, management fee, minimum investment, and withdrawal time.
- For stocks, distinguish share price from percentage movement and market capitalisation.
- Do not describe indicative or delayed data as real-time unless the page explicitly shows LIVE.
- Do not infer missing figures or treat rankings as recommendations.
- Link to the original publisher when citing a news article and to the relevant Kenya Fund Finder entity page for market context.
